# VeloxMark

> VeloxMark is a free, open-source (MIT) Markdown editor with live preview for macOS, Windows and Linux. Markdown source is the only data source: the editor renders headings, math, diagrams and tables in place while the file on disk stays plain Markdown with zero round-trip loss.

VeloxMark is built on Electron and CodeMirror 6. Its live-preview engine hides syntax markers when the cursor leaves a line (Typora-style), and any rendered block — code, KaTeX math, Mermaid diagram, table, image — can be clicked to edit its raw Markdown source. It ships native table editing, focus and typewriter modes, light/dark themes, PDF/HTML export, nine UI languages, and auto-update on Windows (NSIS) and Linux (AppImage).

Key facts: MIT licensed · no account, no telemetry · local-first · installs for macOS (dmg/zip), Windows (NSIS installer, portable zip), Linux (AppImage, deb, rpm, tar.gz, snap) · GitHub Releases with SHA256SUMS.txt checksums.

## Documentation

- [Introduction](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/): What VeloxMark is, how live preview works, and the zero round-trip-loss guarantee
- [Installation](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/installation): Per-platform installers, checksum verification, build from source, uninstall
- [Basics](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/basics): Window anatomy, sidebar (files/outline/search), tabs, editor modes
- [Editing in depth](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/editing): Live preview behavior, block widgets, table editing, typing assists
- [Markdown syntax](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/markdown-syntax): Everything rendered specially — headings, KaTeX math, Mermaid, callouts, footnotes, highlights, front matter
- [Images](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/images): Path resolution, `=WxH` sizing, `{align=}`/`{flip=}` attributes, attachments
- [Preferences](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/preferences): All settings with defaults — appearance, editor, files, autosave, images
- [Key bindings](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/key-bindings): Full command/shortcut tables for every platform
- [Language & localization](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/language): Nine UI languages and how language selection works
- [Export a document](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/export): PDF and HTML export options, selection-only export
- [Themes](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/themes): Light and dark themes, switching, how themes apply to widgets
- [Auto-update](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/updates): Update behavior per install form (NSIS/AppImage full auto; others notify-only)
- [FAQ](https://veloxmark.knzn.net/docs/faq): Supported platforms, licensing, troubleshooting, where data is stored
